note: Pre-registered plan for the one-time hold-out run (README Phase 9). Frozen with the code: nothing below may change after the freeze tag.
procedure: The Phase 5 walk-forward is run unchanged (same code, seeds, tuning trials, alpha grid, costs) with the hold-out budgets added as two more test folds; every model is trained only on budgets before the test budget whose 12m label was resolved on its day 0, so FY2025-26 is trained on all earlier budgets including FY2024-25. The first 12 folds must reproduce the saved Phase 5 predictions (drift check). All models and baselines are reported; none is selected or promoted because of its hold-out result.

primary.rule: IC of the 14 budget-sensitive sectors is at least the bar in BOTH hold-out budgets

secondary.rule: tier1_blend top-3 net return exceeds the equal_weight (all 14) net return in BOTH hold-out budgets
tier1_blend 80% interval coverage over the 28 hold-out forecasts (14 sectors x 2 budgets) lies in 75%-85%
tier2_ranker pooled IC is positive in BOTH hold-out budgets and its top-15 net return exceeds the stock equal_weight net return in BOTH
IT Services (control) is not ranked in the predicted top 3 by tier1_blend in BOTH hold-out budgets

statistics: Two budgets cannot support a significance test; hold-out results are descriptive. FY2024-25's window runs from 2024-07-24 to the next budget on 2025-02-01 (about six months), FY2025-26's from 2025-02-03 to 2026-02-02 (twelve months).
not_included: speech features (no speeches exist; Phase 6 re-run blocked)
company fundamentals and order wins (not built)
